description: WRITE tool — PUBLIC ACTION: publishes the reply on the App Store under the developer's name (now, or after delay_minutes). Overwrites an existing response (Apple keeps one per review and marks it edited). Apple shows it within ~24h: status pending_publish, then published. Needs an Admin-role App Store Connect key. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

body.description: Replace the reply text before posting. Omit to post the current draft.

delay_minutes.description: Schedule instead of posting now (minutes). 0/omitted = post now.

review_id.description: Sonar review id (the `id` of an item from sonar_review_inbox — not Apple's review id).

name: sonar_post_review_reply
title: Post Review Reply
